jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Java Engineer
jobs.description:
**Ready for a challenge?**
--------------------------

  

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.


Whether it’s a Friday\-night feast, a post\-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

**About this role**
-------------------

  

We are seeking a motivated and experienced engineer to join our team as we consolidate fragmented partner data into a global event\-driven architecture. You'll help build tooling that empowers our operations team to manage restaurant partners, breaking down monolithic .NET applications into microservices using Java Spring Framework and Kubernetes. We are big on communication, collaboration and innersourcing across teams.

* ***Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home)***

**These are some of the key components to the position:**
---------------------------------------------------------

  

* Design and implement high\-performance, highly scalable, event\-driven microservices for the partner domain.
* Partner with product teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, and align with cross\-functional teams on API/Event contracts (e.g., OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Confluent).
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code while actively mentoring junior developers and driving code reviews to ensure system maintainability.
* Maintain, investigate, and document the revenue\-driving legacy platform, acting quickly to debug and resolve any operational issues.
* Proactively explore emerging technologies and AI\-driven tools to automate repetitive tasks, simplify full\-stack complexities, and elevate overall code quality.
* Actively participate in team brainstorming sessions, communicate progress on complex features, and remain open to learning and innersourcing across new tech stacks.

**What will you bring to the team?**
------------------------------------

  

* In\-depth knowledge of backend ecosystems (Java/Spring Framework OR C\#/.Net) and design patterns, with expertise building event\-driven microservices using message queues (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS SNS/SQS).
* Experience in full\-stack development, including proficiency in modern front\-end frameworks (such as Vue, React, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts, alongside working knowledge of relational (MySQL) and NoSQL databases.
* Strong background in modern frontend and backend testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Testcontainers) and distributed tracing for microservices (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm charts.
* Familiarity with PHP, broad exposure across multiple backend ecosystems (Java, .NET), and experience with cybersecurity practices.

**At JET, this is how we play**
-------------------------------

  

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best\-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.


Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

  

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.


Fun, fast\-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer\-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

**Inclusion, Diversity \& Belonging**
-------------------------------------

  

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

**What else are we delivering?**
--------------------------------

  

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

**Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!**
----------------------------------------------

 **Recruiter LinkedIN tag:** *\#LI\-AO1*
jobs.reason: TECHNOLOGY_ROLE: Primary backend stack is Java/Spring; .NET is legacy or an alternative ecosystem, not the primary backend stack.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Software Engineering (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
**Werkstudent Software Engineering (w/m/d)**
============================================

Job Requisition ID: 2892
Location:
Ulm, DE, 89077
Company: HENSOLDT Sensors GmbH  

**Über den Bereich**

  



Für den Bereich "Air SIGINT Embedded Software Engineering" suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunikt einen "Werkstudent Software Engineering (w/m/d)" am Standort Ulm.

  


**Deine Aufgaben**

* Bewertung der Voice\-Lösung hinsichtlich Anforderungserfüllung, Stabilität, Lizenzierung, Technologie und Bandbreitenbedarf
* Integration der Lösung in die Zielumgebung sowie ggf. Anbindung an bestehende Infrastruktur (Keycloak / Datenbank) und Erstellung der Software\-Dokumentation
* Spezifikation eines Chat\-Frontends nach Nutzeranforderungen sowie UX/UI\-Vorgaben, inkl. FOSS\-Recherche zu Chat\-Clients für Angular (Vanilla vs. angepasste Lösungen)
* Analyse der Chat\-Features, die eine tiefere Integration mit anderen Komponenten erfordern und Erstellung entsprechender Konzepte
* Entwicklung weiterer Patterns und Templates zur Umsetzung dieser Konzepte sowie Umsetzung in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen Komponententeams

  


**Dein Profil**

  


* Kenntnisse in Webtechnologien, insbesondere Angular / TypeScript
* Kenntnisse in Linux / Containerisierung
* Erfahrung im Scripting (z. B. Bash, Python)
* Interesse an der Arbeit mit Open\-Source\-Software
* Freude an konzeptioneller Arbeit sowie an eigenverantwortlicher Umsetzung

  



Bitte lade bei deiner Bewerbung die aktuell gültige Immatrikulationsbescheinigung hoch.

  



Willst du Teil eines zukunftsorientierten Unternehmens werden? Bist du bereit, Verantwortung in spannenden internationalen und nationalen Projekten zu übernehmen? Dann bist du unser Kandidat!  

Bewirb dich bitte ausschließlich online über unser Karriereportal mit deinem Lebenslauf und deinen Zeugnissen.

  


Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, kannst du dich gerne an unser Recruiting\-Team wenden: jobs@hensoldt.net

  


Erfahre mehr über HENSOLDT und unsere Stellenangebote: www.hensoldt.net/studierende

  

**Bewirb dich jetzt!**

  


HENSOLDT setzt sich für Vielfalt und eine integrative Firmenkultur ein. Daher begrüßen wir alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Identität oder Weltanschauung.


**Become our next pioneer. Apply now and become part of the HENSOLDT team!**


HENSOLDT is committed to diversity and an inclusive corporate culture. We therefore welcome all applications \- regardless of origin, age, gender, disability, identity or ideology.

jobs.title: System Developer Purchasing, Finance and Invoicing
jobs.description:
System Developer – Purchasing, Finance and Invoicing
  
**Location:** Skellefteå, Sweden / Partial Remote
  
**Working method:** Hybrid – approximately 50% remote
  
**Job type:** Consultant
  
**Scope:** 100%
  
**Assignment period:** Immediate until 30 October 2027, with an option for extension until 30 October 2029
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for a skilled and experienced System Developer to work with business systems and integrations within the areas of purchasing, finance and invoicing.
  
The role involves system development, maintenance, integration, troubleshooting and further development of IT systems supporting business\-critical processes. You will work across several technical and business areas and contribute to stable, reliable and efficient digital solutions.
  
Responsibilities
  
The role includes a varied combination of development, maintenance and integration activities, including:
  
Development, maintenance and further development of business systems.
  
Needs analysis, requirements analysis, solution design, troubleshooting and technical support.
  
Development and management of integrations through an integration platform.
  
Implementation and maintenance of integrations between different business systems.
  
Invoicing and invoice management processes, from invoice creation through processing and archiving.
  
Banking and finance\-related solutions, including encryption, signing and handling of payment and reporting files.
  
Development and maintenance of financial accounting solutions.
  
Creation and maintenance of reports for financial monitoring and analysis.
  
Support for budget\-related processes and financial reporting.
  
Collaboration with developers, business specialists and other stakeholders.
  
Contributing to continuous improvement, automation and digitalisation of business processes.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
The successful candidate must meet competency level 2 and have:
  
Fluent Swedish communication skills, both verbally and in writing.
  
At least 3 years of experience developing, managing and further developing the same IT system throughout its lifecycle. The required experience must relate to one and the same system and cannot be achieved by combining corresponding lifecycle phases from different systems.
  
At least 3 years of experience in system development using Visual Studio and/or VS Code, including integrated version control with Git.
  
At least 3 years of professional experience with C\#/.NET development.
  
At least 3 years of experience with an additional scripting or backend language alongside C\#, such as PowerShell or Python.
  
At least 3 years of experience working with IT systems and/or digital services in production environments with requirements for availability and continuity.
  
At least 3 years of experience analysing, designing and implementing requirements.
  
At least 3 years of experience working within a development team.
  
At least 3 years of experience implementing integrations where an integration platform is the primary solution for system integration, business logic and communication between systems.
  
At least 3 years of experience creating and maintaining reports, for example using Microsoft Power BI.
  
At least 3 years of experience working with relational databases, including development and maintenance of SQL queries, stored procedures, functions and views.
  
  

Additional Experience
  
  

**Experience in the following areas is required:**  

Working in cross\-functional teams.
  
Implementing integrations with Microsoft Dynamics/Xellent.
  
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  
TEIS integration platform.
  
Automating and digitalising business processes using established automation platforms such as Power Automate or equivalent. Script\-based automation alone does not meet this requirement.
  
Working within the energy industry, particularly with B2C and B2B invoicing.
  
Financial accounting.
  
Azure DevOps or equivalent tools for planning, coordinating and monitoring development activities.
  
  

Technical Environment
  
The role involves working with a broad range of technologies and platforms, including:
  
C\# / .NET
  
Visual Studio / VS Code
  
Git
  
PowerShell and/or Python
  
SQL Server
  
Microsoft Power BI
  
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
  
TEIS
  
Microsoft Dynamics/Xellent
  
Power Automate
  
Azure DevOps or equivalent development\-management tools
  
  

Assignment Details
  
**Start date:** Immediate
  
**End date:** 30 October 2027
  
**Extension:** Option to extend until 30 October 2029
  
**Location:** Skellefteå, Sweden
  
**Remote work:** Approximately 50%
  
**Scope:** 100%
  
**Job type:** Consultant
  
We are looking for a structured and solution\-oriented system developer who can contribute to both ongoing development and long\-term management of business\-critical IT systems, integrations and digital processes.
  
**Application deadline:** 28 September 2026

jobs.title: Project Development Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29035
Category: Engineering \- Other
Job Type: Full\-time  

We are looking for a Project Development Senior Engineer with at least 5 years’ experience providing leadership and technical guidance in all aspects of HV substation design services.


In support of ESB’s strategic objectives of decarbonising electricity, building resilient infrastructure and empowering clients, you will focus on providing substation design services for the development phase of high voltage substation transmission and distribution projects.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
The role will also include some/all the following work:  

* Owning the project deliverables during the Project Development phase, in particular business case success measures including time, cost, scope \& quality whilst acting as the PSDP for this phase of the project.
* Developing the Project Brief as set out by Network Assets and/or EirGrid into a viable Project Management Plan ready to transition from Project Development to Project Delivery stage.
* Delivering for approval the Conceptual Physical Designs, Scope of Works, Project Costs and Project Management Plans to agreed target timelines.
* For Engineer, Procure \& Contract (EPC) and Design and Build (D\&B) projects, aid the development of all relevant documents, in conjunction with the Project Delivery team and support the procurement process for the project.
* Manage the overall project deliverables and coordinate inputs with the relevant stakeholders at project development stage.
* Provide leadership and technical guidance to Project Development team members in all aspects of the project conception
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* A minimum of five years’ experience in substation design.
* A good understanding of all elements of substation planning, design, costing, construction and commissioning.
* A strong work ethic with a clear focus on delivery to EMPs safety, time, quality and cost objectives.
* Effective commercial and project management capability.
* The demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and report writing skills.
* A proven track record of success contributing to the training and development of technical professionals.
* A flexible approach to work, especially where necessary to meet agreed KPIs.
  

**Desirable**


Full drivers' licence and relevant competencies to visit ESBN substations and sites on their own.  

* 

**Qualifications**
**Essential**
* Third level qualification or appropriate experience
  

**Desirable**
It is preferred that the candidate has achieved the following:
* PSDP Competency or CDMC equivalent
* Site Working Competencies
  

**Location**
The position is based in Engineering and Major Projects Offices in the Sidings, Dublin 2, or Eastgate, Cork but the role may require a certain amount of travel within Ireland.


Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration **at least two days per week**. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

  

**Reporting to**
The Project Development Senior Engineer will report to a Technical Programme Manager within Networks Projects Development.

  

**Why Work with Us?**  

* Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension
* Access to staff well\-being programmes
* Generous parental leave entitlements
* Strong values\-based and inclusive culture
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
* Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted
  

**Salary**
€59,000 \- €70,000 Per annum  

  

**Closing Date**
05th October 2026  

**Interview**
Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:  

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive
  

More information available on Our People Promise  

**Notes**
Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.  

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.
